Card Q&A.q: Is a "while your opponent has no Digimon with XX" condition also met when my opponent has no Digimon?

Effect: [Your Turn] While your opponent has no Digimon with digivolution cards in play, this Digimon gains ＜Jamming＞. (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] Trash 1 digivolution card from the bottom of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
